plain_english_policy: The item asks for a funding level without specifying the amount or direction (increase/decrease), making it impossible to determine if the stance is conservative or progressive.
evidence_quote: Indicate the funding levels you will support for the following general categories. Select one level only.
review_reason: The prompt asks candidates to select a 'level' but does not define what constitutes an increase (progressive) versus decrease (conservative), rendering the direction indeterminate without external context on baseline spending or candidate history.
